title: Biological Evolution in a Multidimensional Fitness Landscape
summary: Multi-block molecular model of evolution with fitness as function of mean allele types. Relevant for Collatz fitness landscape analogy.

title: Bioattractors: dynamical systems theory and the evolution of regulatory processes
summary: Connects dynamical systems attractors to biological development. Basin of attraction = convergence basin of Collatz.

title: Adaptive Fitness Landscape for Replicator Systems
summary: Studies when Wright's adaptive landscape metaphor holds exactly in mathematical models of evolution.
